blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: AI agents are increasingly expected to act as AI scientists, which requires three increasingly open abilities: carrying out a given computational workflow correctly, choosing the next measurements from a given design space, and designing their own experiments. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate the first two abilities, in a terminal or in a closed loop that selects from predefined candidates. Evaluating the third ability requires reliably executing an experiment that an agent designs, with readings grounded in a real laboratory. We introduce TwinLab-Bench, which evaluates AI scientists on self-designed experiments in 52 tasks from laboratories in the physical sciences, the life sciences, and engineering. The benchmark supports more than 100 experimental action types, and the agent's report is scored by comparison with a hidden answer taken from real laboratory records. Each task has its own TwinLab agent, an agent that serves as the environment and executes the experiments that the tested agent designs, reading the raw materials of the laboratory and calling calculators that are built from its records. Compared with a language model that sees only the task description, the TwinLab agent almost eliminates readings that deviate from the real records and inconsistent answers to a repeated request, and closed-book probes control for answers recalled from memory. We find that these tasks remain hard for frontier models: the strongest, Claude Fable 5.2, averages a score of only 45.0, and we conduct an empirical study of where it fails.
blocks.zh: 人们越来越期望AI代理作为AI的科学家,这需要三种日益开放的能力:正确执行特定计算工作流程,从特定设计空间中选择下一个测量,以及设计自己的实验. 现有基准主要通过一个终端或从预先确定的候选人中选择的闭环来评价前两个能力. 评估第三种能力需要可靠地实施一种由物剂设计的实验,其读数以真正的实验室为基础。 我们介绍TwinLab-Bench, 评估AI科学家在物理科学、生命科学和工程等实验室的52项任务中自行设计的实验。 该基准支持100多种实验动作类型,与从真实的实验室记录中提取的隐藏答案相比,剂的报告被打分. 每项任务都有自己的TwinLab剂,一种作为环境的剂,并且执行被测试的剂设计的实验,读取实验室的原材料,调用从其记录中构建的计算器. 与只看到任务描述的语言模型相比,TwinLab代理几乎消除了偏离真实记录的读数和对重复请求的不一致的回答,并且关闭本对从内存中召回答案的控制. 我们发现,对于前沿模型来说,这些任务仍然是艰巨的:最强者克劳德·费布尔5.2,平均只有45.0分,我们对其失败之处进行了实证研究.

blocks.en:
AI is advancing science in more and more of the research process, and the AI scientists that the field now builds need three increasingly open abilities ( Gottweis et al., 2026 ; Ghareeb et al., 2026 ) .
The first is carrying out a given computational workflow correctly, such as analyzing a given dataset ( Mitchener et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Terminal-Bench-Science Team, 2026 ; Mitchener et al., 2025b ) .
The second is choosing the next measurements from a given design space ( Duan et al., 2025 ; Gandhi et al., 2025 ; Roohani et al., 2025 ; Wen & Liu, 2026 ) .
The third is designing their own experiments, and automated laboratories are starting to run such experiments ( Boiko et al., 2023 ; Szymanski et al., 2023 ) .
The third ability is the hardest of the three, but few science benchmarks test it.
blocks.zh:
AI正在越来越多的研究过程中推进科学,而这个领域现在建立的AI科学家需要三种日益开放的能力(Gottweis等人,2026年;Ghareeb等人,2026年)。
第一个是正确进行特定的计算工作流程,例如分析一个特定的数据集(Mitchener等人,2025a); Chen等人,2025年;终端-Bench-Science Team, 2026; Mitchener等人, 2025b.).
第二是选择从特定设计空间进行下一次测量(Duan等人,2025年;Gandhi等人,2025年;Ruhani等人,2025年;Wen & Liu,2026年)。
第三是设计自己的实验,自动化实验室开始进行这种实验(Boiko等人,2023年;Szymanski等人,2023年)。
第三个能力是三个能力中最难的,但很少有科学基准对其进行测试.

blocks.en:
Existing science benchmarks test whether an agent can recall knowledge ( Laurent et al., 2024 ) , work on given data ( Mitchener et al., 2025a ) , or search a given space ( Duan et al., 2025 ) , as figure 2 (a) shows.
These abilities work on data that the task provides in advance, but the third ability, designing their own experiments, needs an environment that returns real data for new experiments. Figure 2 (b) orders these environments by how close they come to a real laboratory.
Fixed results support no new experiments.
A simulator ( Jansen et al., 2024 ; Duan et al., 2025 ; Gandhi et al., 2025 ) or a replay ( Roohani et al., 2025 ; Wen & Liu, 2026 ) returns new results, which come only from written rules or from recorded experiments.
The goal of the experiment environment is a real laboratory, which returns real results for any experiment that an agent designs ( Bran et al., 2024 ; Tom et al., 2024 ) .
We move one step from simulators and replays toward this goal with a twin of each real laboratory, and we build TwinLab-Bench on these twins.

这些能力工作在任务事先提供的数据上,但第三种能力,即设计自己的实验,需要一种为新的实验返回真实数据的环境. 图2(b)根据这些环境到真正的实验室的距离而定。
固定结果支持没有新的实验。
模拟器(Jansen等人,2024年;Duan等人,2025年;Gandhi等人,2025年)或重播(Ruhani等人,2025年;Wen & Liu,2026年)返回新结果,这些结果只来自书面规则或记录的实验.
实验环境的目标是一个真正的实验室,它为任何一种剂设计的任何实验返回真正的结果(Bran等人,2024年;Tom等人,2024年).

blocks.en:
We propose the TwinLab agent to build a reliable twin of each laboratory.
The TwinLab agent is a coding agent that serves as the environment, so it uses tools to read the files of the laboratory and runs programs on them.
Each task has its own TwinLab agent with the materials and the calculators of its laboratory.
For an experiment that the laboratory performed, the TwinLab agent reads the raw materials, often combining several records, and returns the result that the laboratory recorded.
For an experiment that the laboratory did not perform, it runs calculators, which are deterministic programs that we write from the data of this laboratory, for example by fitting a physical model to its measurements.
Each calculator extends the record only to nearby settings, with a basis that we write down when we build the task.
blocks.zh:
我们建议TwinLab代理 建立一个可靠的双胞胎 每个实验室。
TwinLab代理是一种作为环境的编码代理,因此它使用工具来读取实验室的文件,并在它们上运行程序.
每项任务都有自己的TwinLab剂及其实验室的材料和计算器.
对于实验室进行的一项实验,TwinLab剂会读取原料,经常结合多个记录,并返回实验室记录的结果.
对于一个实验室没有进行的实验,它运行着计算器, 它们是我们从这个实验室的数据中写入的确定性程序, 例如通过在它的测量中安装一个物理模型。
每个计算器只将记录扩展至附近的设置,其基础是我们在构建任务时所记.

blocks.en:
TwinLab-Bench consists of 52 tasks, and each task comes from the records of a real laboratory in the physical sciences, the life sciences, or engineering.
The tested agent, which we call the actor agent, receives the notebooks, raw data, and interim conclusions that the laboratory had at one point of its work, requests the experiments that it designs within a budget, and submits a report that we score by comparing it with what the laboratory later found, as section 3.1 shows for four tasks.
Our experiments show three properties of TwinLab-Bench.
(1) The score comes from the experiments, because without budget Opus 5.5 and DeepSeek-flash pass none of the tasks.
(2) The actor agent’s conclusion follows the true state of the laboratory that it measures.
(3) The twin predicts hidden recorded readings within a median error of 2.47% even outside the recorded conditions, and it blocks all 9 attempts to exploit it.
blocks.zh:
TwinLab-Bench由52项任务组成,每个任务都来自物理科学,生命科学,或工程学中真实实验室的记录.
被测试的代理,我们称之为演员代理,接收了实验室在工作某一点上拥有的笔记本,原始数据和临时结论,要求它在预算范围内设计的实验,并提交了一份报告,我们通过比较它与实验室后来发现的东西而得分,正如第3.1节显示的四项任务.
我们的实验显示了TwinLab-Bench的三个特性.
(1)得分来自实验,因为没有预算Opus 5.5和DeepSeek-flash都没有通过任何任务.
(2) 行为者的结论遵循其测量实验室的真实状况。
(3)双胞胎预测在2.47%的中位误差内,甚至在所记录的条件之外,隐藏记录的读数,它阻止了所有9次尝试加以利用.

blocks.en:
On TwinLab-Bench, the strongest frontier model averages a score of only 45.0 out of 100.
Opus 5.5 still loses part of the score on decisions that it states in full before the run, and its most common decision error is accepting a mechanism without a discriminating test.
blocks.zh:
在TwinLab-Bench上,最强的边疆模型平均得分只有45.0分的100分.
Opus 5.5仍然在跑前完全声明的决定上失去部分得分,其最常见的决定错误是接受一种机制而没有歧视性的测试.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. • TwinLab-Bench, a public benchmark that tests whether an agent can design its own experiments, built on the records of real laboratories and released with its evaluation code. • The twin of a real laboratory, made of a TwinLab agent, the raw records of the laboratory, and the calculators that we write from these records. • An empirical study that locates where frontier models lose score and which experimental abilities they lack.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 · TwinLab-Bench,是检验代理人是否能够设计自己的实验的公开基准,以真实实验室的记录为基础,并用其评价代码发布。 一个真正的实验室的双胞胎,由TwinLab的代理制造,实验室的原始记录,以及我们从这些记录中书写的计算器。 一项实证研究,找出前沿模型失分之处和它们缺乏的实验能力.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Most science benchmarks give the agent no laboratory for running new experiments.
Question sets test whether an agent recalls scientific knowledge ( Rein et al., 2024 ; Phan et al., 2026 ; Laurent et al., 2024 ; Laurent et al., 2026 ) or how to change a published protocol ( Sivakumar et al., 2026 ) , and data-analysis benchmarks hand the agent a dataset and a question ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Mitchener et al., 2025a ) .
AI scientist systems such as Kosmos also automate this kind of analysis at scale ( Mitchener et al., 2025b ) .
Terminal benchmarks ( Merrill et al., 2026 ; Terminal-Bench-Science Team, 2026 ) and benchmarks of automated machine-learning research ( Chan et al., 2025 ; Wijk et al., 2024 ; Starace et al., 2025 ) let the agent run new experiments, but these experiments are programs inside a computer.
End-to-end systems already write and review such research ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , and end-to-end research benchmarks run the agent on the given data and code of a study ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .
Benchmarks of these four kinds cannot evaluate how an agent chooses physical experiments that cost time and consume scarce materials.
blocks.zh:
大多数科学基准都使毒剂没有进行新实验的实验室.
问题确定一个制剂是否回顾科学知识(Rein等人,2024年;Phan等人,2026年;Laurent等人,2024年;Laurent等人,2026年)或如何改变已公布的规程(Sivakumar等人,2026年),以及数据分析基准向制剂提供数据集和一个问题(Chen等人,2025年;Mitchener等人,2025年a年)。
AI 科学家系统,如宇宙系统,还使这种分析在规模上自动化(Mitchener等人,2025b)。 。 。 。
终端基准(Merrill等人,2026年;Terminal-Bench-Science Team,2026年)和自动机器学习研究的基准(Chan等人,2025年;Wijk等人,2024年;Starace等人,2025年)让代理人进行新的实验,但这些实验都是计算机内部的程序.
端对端系统已经编写和审查此类研究(Lu等人,2026年),端对端研究基准运行特定数据和研究代码上的剂(徐等人,2026年;周等人,2026年a; 杨等,2026).
这四种基准无法评价一种剂如何选择耗费时间和消耗稀有材料的物理实验。

blocks.en:
Interactive environments answer the experimental requests of an agent with readings from a simulation, a replay, or a language model.
Text worlds and equation models ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Jansen et al., 2024 ; Duan et al., 2025 ; Gandhi et al., 2025 ; Rowstron & Chadha, 2026 ) answer any request, and their readings follow the rules written into the environment.
EmbodiedLab ( Gao et al., 2026 ) tests how agents operate instruments in a physics simulator on textbook experiments, while TwinLab-Bench leaves out physical operation and tests experimental decisions on problems from real laboratories.
Replays of published measurements ( Roohani et al., 2025 ; Wen & Liu, 2026 ) return real readings, and the agent picks its next experiment among the recorded conditions.
Learned world models predict the outcome of an action ( Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018 ) , and language models serve as such world models for planning ( Hao et al., 2023 ) and for text-based games ( Wang et al., 2024 ) .
Language models also play patients ( Schmidgall et al., 2024 ) and users ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Barres et al., 2025 ) in agent evaluations, and they answer from general knowledge; evaluations of such simulators find that their feedback departs from real environments and users ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) .
AgentBeats ( Berkeley RDI, 2026 ) packages a benchmark as an agent that sets the tasks, the environment, and the scoring for the agent under test.
TwinLab-Bench splits this role between a TwinLab agent that serves as the environment and a judge agent that scores the report.
These environments do not answer the experiments that an agent composes with readings from the records of a real laboratory, so they cannot evaluate how an agent designs its own experiments.
blocks.zh:
互动环境以模拟,重播,或语言模型的读数回答代理的实验请求.
文本世界和方程式模型(Wang等人,2022年;Jansen等人,2024年;Duan等人,2025年;Gandhi等人,2025年;Rowstron & Chadha,2026年)回答任何请求,他们的读数遵循了写进环境的规则.
EmphysicalLab(Gao等人,2026年)在教科书实验上测试物理模拟器中的剂操作仪器,而TwinLab-Bench则将物理操作排除在外,并测试真实实验室对问题的实验决定.
重播已公布的测量结果(Roohani等人,2025年;Wen & Liu,2026年) 返回真实的读数,代理从记录的条件中选择下一次实验.
学习世界模型预测一项行动的结果(Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018),语言模型作为规划(Hao等人, 2023)和文字游戏(Wang等人, 2024)的世界模型.
语言模型也会扮演病人 (Schmidgall等人,2024年)和用户(姚等人,2025年;Barres等人,2025年)在代理评价中,他们从一般知识中回答;对这些模拟器的评价发现其反馈偏离了真实环境和用户(刘等人,2026年;周等人,2026年b).
Agent Beats (Berkeley RDI, 2026) 包了一个基准作为代理设定任务,环境,以及被测试代理的评分.
TwinLab-Bench将这个角色分为担任环境的TwinLab代理和评分报告的法官代理.
这些环境不回答一个物剂用真实实验室记录的读数来构成的实验,因此无法评价物剂如何设计自己的实验.

blocks.en: 3 TwinLab-Bench
blocks.zh: 3个 双篮球

blocks.en:
TwinLab-Bench consists of 52 tasks, and each task defines a twin of one real laboratory, a budget, and a rubric.
In a run, the tested model, which we call the actor agent, sends experimental requests to the TwinLab agent of the task, an agent that serves as the environment and returns the results, as figure 4 shows.
The actor agent finally submits a report, and a judge agent scores this report by comparing it with the hidden truth.
All TwinLab agents run the same program, and the materials and the calculators of each task make it the twin of its laboratory, with the engineering details in Appendix 13.1 .
blocks.zh:
TwinLab-Bench由52项任务组成,每项任务都定义了一个真正的实验室,一个预算,一个标题的双胞胎.
在一次运行中,我们称之为演员代理的测试模型向任务TwinLab代理发出实验请求,这个代理充当环境并返回结果,如图4所示.
演员代理最终提交了一份报告,一名法官代理通过将报告与隐藏的真相进行比较来评分这份报告.
所有TwinLab代理都运行同一程序,每项任务的材料和计算器使其成为实验室的双胞胎,工程细节见附录13.1.

blocks.en: 3.1 Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务

blocks.en:
We select the tasks from about 375 candidate sources, and each task is built on a real research record, such as an open laboratory notebook, raw instrument exports, a paper with its supplementary material, or a public dataset, as section 3.1 shows.
Most tasks are adapted from the records of one laboratory.
In some of them the laboratory itself met the problem and later solved it, and in the others the problem lies in the real data of the laboratory.
Their answers come from a later notebook entry, a publication, a correction, or a reanalysis of the raw data.
The few remaining tasks are grounded syntheses, as Appendix 14 describes.
blocks.zh:
我们从大约375个候选来源中挑选任务,每项任务都建立在真正的研究记录上,例如开放的实验室笔记本,原始仪器出口,带有其补充材料的纸张,或者如第3.1节所示的公共数据集.
大多数任务是根据一个实验室的记录改编的。
在其中一些国家,实验室本身就遇到了问题,后来解决了它,而在另一些国家,问题在于实验室的真实数据。
他们的答案来自后来的笔记本条目,出版物,更正,或对原始数据的重新分析.
如附录14所述,其余的几项任务都是基础综合。

blocks.en:
We choose a cutoff point in the record, which is a date or a clearly defined state of the laboratory, and split the record into two parts.
The data, protocols, and interim conclusions that the laboratory had before the cutoff point are handed to the actor agent.
What the source records show after the cutoff point is given only to the TwinLab agent and to the judge agent, and we call this part the hidden truth.
An expert route taken from the record averages a score of 97.8 out of 100 when we replay it in the twin of each task.
Every task also passes a coverage review, which confirms that the standard experiments of the field can be simulated, and Appendix 14 lists all tasks and their construction.
blocks.zh:
我们在记录中选择一个截断点,即日期或明确的实验室状态,并将记录分为两部分.
实验室在截断点之前掌握的数据,协议和临时结论交给了演员代理.
线人记录显示在截断点之后 仅给予TwinLab探员和法官探员 我们称这部分为隐藏真相
从记录中选取的专家路线,每任务双打时,平均得分97.8分.
每项任务也都会通过覆盖审查,确认现场的标准实验可以模拟,附录14列出了所有任务及其构造.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Scorecard of science benchmarks. Each row is a benchmark, and each bar splits its tasks by the levels in the key of its column. Orange boxes mark the main weakness of each group of benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 图5:科学基准计分卡。 每行是一个基准,每栏按其列中键的级别将其任务划分. 橙色盒标志着每组基准的主要弱点.

blocks.en:
The tasks take three forms.
Most tasks are claim reviews, which ask the actor agent to decide which conclusions of the laboratory hold and how to test them.
Troubleshooting tasks ask for the cause of a clear failure and a working procedure, and research-campaign tasks ask for an executable procedure toward a research goal.
Some tasks offer no experiments, and the actor agent analyzes only the raw records that the laboratory already has.
blocks.zh:
任务有三种形式。
大多数任务是要求审查,要求行为者代理人决定实验室持有的哪些结论以及如何对其进行测试。
解决问题的任务需要明确的失败原因和工作程序,而研究运动的任务则需要可执行的程序,以实现研究目标。
有些任务不提供实验,演员代理只分析实验室已经拥有的原始记录.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Task sources. Four example tasks that come from journal papers or lab notebooks, with the finding that each task targets.
blocks.zh: 图3:任务来源。 四个实例任务来自期刊论文或实验室笔记本,发现每个任务都针对目标.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Task sources. Four example tasks that come from journal papers or lab notebooks, with the finding that each task targets.
blocks.zh: 图3:任务来源。 四个实例任务来自期刊论文或实验室笔记本,发现每个任务都针对目标.

blocks.en:
The actor agent proposes its own hypotheses and composes its own experiments.
It describes each experiment in natural language and decides which actions to run, on which materials, with which settings, in which order, and how many times.
Across the benchmark the laboratories support more than 100 action types.
Each laboratory lists its procedures and the parameter options of its equipment and reagents, and the actor agent combines them into experiments and can also request values outside the list.
These lists contain no experiment and no step of the solution, as Appendix 13.1 details.
In its sandbox, the actor agent can analyze the handoff materials freely with a shell and Python, but new readings come only from experimental requests to the TwinLab agent, and every request costs budget.
The actor agent can search the web with the source record blocked, and it finally submits a report with its conclusions and recommended procedure.
blocks.zh:
演员代理提出自己的假设,并作曲自己的实验.
它用自然语言描述每个实验,并决定要运行的动作,在何种材料上,用何种设置,用何种顺序,以及多少次.
在整个基准中,实验室支持100多种行动类型。
每个实验室都列出其程序和其设备和试剂的参数选项,演员代理将这些程序和选项合并到实验中,也可以在列表之外请求值.
这些清单没有试验,也没有解决步骤,如附录13.1的细节。
在其沙盒中,演员代理可以用贝壳和Python自由分析交接材料,但新的读数只能从实验请求到TwinLab代理,每个请求都花费预算.
演员代理可以搜索被封杀的源记录的网络,最终提交附有其结论和建议程序的报告.

blocks.en:
We control the difficulty of the tasks with five properties that make them depend on experimental judgment.
(1) The budget of each task, counted in units such as laboratory days or wells, is one to three times the amount that the expert route uses for most tasks, so it covers the expert route and a few plausible hypotheses but not all options.
(2) Scarce materials named in the record cannot be recovered once used.
(3) An artifact has a plausible benign explanation.
(4) A measurement that looks decisive has another possible cause, for instance when all samples measured on one date also come from one batch.
(5) In some tasks the correct answer is that the question cannot be decided within the budget.
Overall, for tasks adapted from real records, these five situations are taken from the record, and we add no problem to the record.
blocks.zh:
我们控制着任务的困难 5个属性 使得它们依赖于实验判断
(1)每项任务的预算,按实验室日或井等单位计算,是专家路线用于大多数任务的数额的一至三倍,因此,它包括专家路线和几个可行的假设,但不是所有选择.
(2) 记录中标明的稀有材料一旦使用就无法回收。
(3) 文物有可信的良性解释。
(4) 一种看来具有决定性的测量方法有另一个可能的原因,例如,在一个日期测量的所有样品也来自一个批次。
(5) 在一些任务中,正确的答案是,这个问题不能在预算范围内决定。
总体而言,对于从真实记录中改编的任务,这五种情况都从记录中取而代之,我们没有给记录增加任何问题.

blocks.en: 3.2 The TwinLab Agent
blocks.zh: 3.2 双实验室代理人

blocks.en:
The environment of each task is a twin of one specific laboratory, made of a TwinLab agent and the task materials of this laboratory.
The task materials contain the full record of the laboratory with its raw files, the calculators that we write from this record, and the hidden truth.
The TwinLab agent handles each experimental request in three steps.
First, it looks for a basis in the task materials, often combining several records.
Second, it takes the recorded value of a condition that the record contains on comparable material or runs calculator commands in a shell.
Third, it writes these numbers as an observation in the instrument’s own format and returns a matching real image when one exists.
The environment code writes a session record after every request, so the TwinLab agent keeps the state that earlier requests left, such as a sample already used up.
Its tools only read files, search text, and run the calculators.
blocks.zh:
每项任务的环境都是由一个特定的实验室组成的双体,由一个TwinLab剂和这个实验室的任务材料制成.
任务材料中包含了实验室的全部记录及其原始文件,我们从这个记录中书写的计算器,以及隐藏的真相.
TwinLab代理分三步处理每个实验请求.
首先,它寻找任务材料的基础,经常结合若干记录。
第二,它需要记录一个条件的记录值,即记录包含在可比材料上或运行一个贝壳中的计算命令.
第三,它将这些数字写成仪器本身格式的一种观察,并在存在时返回匹配的真实图像。
环境代码在每次请求后都会写一个会话记录,因此TwinLab代理保持了先前请求左侧的状态,比如一个样本已经用完了.
它的工具只读取文件,搜索文本,运行计算器.

blocks.en:
A calculator is a deterministic program written for one task from the laboratory’s own data, for example by resampling the recorded measurements, by fitting a physical model to the record, or by filling a real instrument’s export template.
The TwinLab agent follows two further rules. • Noise. Independent samples receive noise at the measured repeatability. • Simulation limits. A quantity that neither the record nor the literature constrains is marked as a simulation limit, costs nothing, and is reported as not being an experimental result.
blocks.zh:
计算器是一个确定性程序,用于从实验室自己的数据中为一项任务撰写,例如通过对所记录的测量数据进行再模版,在记录中安装一个物理模型,或者填写一个真正的仪器出口模板。
TwinLab代理遵循另外两项规则. • 噪音。 独立样品在测得的重复性时得到噪音. • 模拟限制。 记录和文献都没有约束的数量被标记为模拟极限,成本不高,被报告为不是实验结果.

blocks.en: Noise. Independent samples receive noise at the measured repeatability.
blocks.zh: 噪声。 独立样品在测得的重复性时得到噪音.

blocks.en: Simulation limits. A quantity that neither the record nor the literature constrains is marked as a simulation limit, costs nothing, and is reported as not being an experimental result.
blocks.zh: 模拟极限. 记录和文献都没有约束的数量被标记为模拟极限,成本不高,被报告为不是实验结果.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Mean score versus the cost of the actor agent ; models run at high effort by default.
blocks.zh: 图6:平均得分与演员代理的成本比;模型默认运行速度高。

blocks.en:
The calculators extend the record only locally.
An extrapolated value carries a basis that we establish through a literature search when the task is built, typically an interpolation between two recorded settings or a dependence documented in the literature, and this basis is written into the task item by item. Section 4.3 tests how much the results depend on these extensions.
blocks.zh:
计算器只在本地扩展记录.
推算值包含一个基础,我们在任务构建时通过文献搜索建立这个基础,一般是在文献中记载的两个已录入的设置或依赖之间进行插值,这个基础逐项写入任务项. 第4.3节检验了结果在多大程度上取决于这些扩展。

blocks.en:
The TwinLab agent needs the hidden truth because the readings have to agree with the true state of the laboratory, such as a cause that only appears later in the record.
It answers only what an experiment returns, and Appendix 13.1 lists the rules that the environment code enforces. lists what each role can see.
blocks.zh:
TwinLab代理需要隐藏的真相,因为读数必须与实验室的真实状态一致,例如只出现在记录后面的原因.
它只回答实验返回的内容,附录13.1列出了环境代码执行的规则. 列出每个角色所能看到的。

blocks.en: 3.3 Scoring
blocks.zh: 3.3 分数

blocks.en:
The rubric of each task consists of items with conditions for full and partial credit ( Starace et al., 2025 ; Arora et al., 2025 ) .
Most items belong to two components. Conclusion items check whether the report states the correct answer, and verification items check whether the report reaches this answer from evidence that the actor agent obtained in this run, so a key finding of a task is often split into one item of each kind.
blocks.zh:
每项任务的标题由具备全部或部分信贷条件的项目组成(Starace等人,2025年;Arora等人,2025年)。
大多数物品属于两个组成部分。 结论项目检查报告是否给出了正确的答案,核查项目检查报告是否从行为者代理在此次运行中获得的证据中达到这个答案,因此任务的关键发现往往被分成一个每样项目.

blocks.en:
The score of each task is rescaled to 0 to 100, and each task marks a few core items whose failure makes the report wrong; when any core item misses full credit, the run scores 0.
We report the mean score over all tasks.
The judge agent is a vision-language model that serves as the judge ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , reads the full task, the interaction log, and the report, and cites the report text or the request number for every item.
Every core item with full credit is checked twice more by independent calls, and the item scores 0 when either check fails.
We freeze the rubric before looking at the final evaluation runs.
blocks.zh:
每项任务的得分调整为0至100分,每项任务都标出几个核心项目,其失败使报告出错;当任何核心项目缺失全部信用时,运行得分 零点
我们报告所有任务的平均得分。
评委代理是一个视觉语言模型,担任评委(郑等人,2023年),阅读全部任务,互动日志,以及报告,并引用每件的报告文本或请求号.
每个有完全信用的核心项目都要通过独立通话再检查两次,当检查失败时项目得分为0.
在看最后评估之前,我们先冻结标题。

blocks.en:
The judge agent also audits the environment, and a run is invalid when a reading leaks the hidden truth, contradicts earlier observations or physics in a way that matters for scoring, or refuses a relevant experiment that a real laboratory can run.
A deterministic script replays every calculator command to check the state, the billing, and the numbers.
A static check scans the content that reaches the actor agent through its tools, and a run that receives a blocked string of the source is invalid, as Appendix 13.1 details.
blocks.zh:
法官代理人还审核环境,当阅读泄露隐藏的真相,以对评分很重要的方式与先前的观测或物理相矛盾,或者拒绝真正的实验室可以运行的相关实验时,运行无效.
一个决定性的脚本重放每个计算器命令来检查状态,计费,以及数字.
静态检查扫描通过它的工具到达的演员代理的内容,接收源的阻断字符串的运行无效,作为附录13.1的细节.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Comparison with Existing Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.1 与现有基准的比较

blocks.en: The scorecard of figure 5 compares TwinLab-Bench with 8 existing benchmarks item by item on scale and diversity, realism, and memorization control, and TwinLab-Bench is the only benchmark in the comparison that combines a wide range of experiments with real problems and real readings, as Appendix 11 discusses.
blocks.zh: 图5的记分卡将TwinLab-Bench与按规模和多样性,现实主义,记忆控制等项目分列的8个现有基准项目进行比较,TwinLab-Bench是比较中唯一一个将各种实验与真实问题和真实读数相结合的基准,附录11讨论了这一点.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
We evaluate 13 models as actor agents, running the GPT models in Codex and the other models in Claude Code.
The TwinLab agent and the judge agent run on DeepSeek-flash for every actor agent.
We report cost together with score following Kapoor et al. (2024) ; figure 6 counts the cost of the actor agent, and the TwinLab agent and the judge agent add about 55 USD for all tasks, as table 10 shows.
blocks.zh:
我们评价13个模型是演员代理,在Codex运行GPT模型,在Claude Code运行其他模型.
TwinLab代理和法官代理 运行在DeepSeek-flash 为每一个演员代理。
正如表10所示,我们报告成本与Kapor等人(2024年)的得分;图6计算了演员代理人的费用,TwinLab代理人和法官代理人为所有任务增加约55美元。

blocks.en:
As figure 6 shows, Claude Fable 5.2 scores 45.0 on average and Claude Opus 5.5 scores 40.2, and the other actor agents score between 5.4 and 31.7. Table 7 lists the scores by division and task form.
For 127 of the 136 pairs of actor agents, with each reasoning effort of a model counted as one actor agent, the actor agent with the higher mean score also scores higher on more tasks than it scores lower, and a paired comparison over tasks separates 66 of the 75 pairs whose mean scores differ by at least 10, as Appendix 6 shows.
We find that (1) the score tends to rise with the logarithm of the cost, and both a larger model and a higher reasoning effort raise the score, and (2) the differences between actor agents hold across many tasks.
blocks.zh:
如图6所示,克劳德5.2平均得分45.0,克劳德·奥普斯5.5平均得分40.2,其他演员代理得分在5.4至31.7之间. 表7按司和任务表列出了分数.
对于136对演员代理中127对,每个模型的推理努力都算作一个演员代理,平均分数较高的演员代理在任务分数也比其分数低的多,与任务作对比较,将75对中平均分数相差至少10对中的66对分开,如附录6所示.
我们发现(1)分数往往随成本的对数而上升,一个更大的模型和更高的推理努力都会提高分数,(2)演员代理之间的差别贯穿许多任务.

blocks.en:
With a fixed rule, we select 21 tasks whose final reports include both correct and wrong ones, which we divide by the hidden truth without looking at their scores.
In 19 of these 21 tasks, every correct report has a higher total score than every wrong report, by 0.46 of the maximum score on average, as Appendix 7.3 shows.
The judge agent is stable, repeating a judgment has little effect, and two judge agents agree on the pass verdict in 19 of 20 runs, as Appendix 7.1 and 7.2 show.
blocks.zh:
有了固定的规则,我们选择了21项任务,其最后报告包括正确和错误的任务,我们用隐藏的真理来划分,而不看他们的得分.
在这21项任务中,19项任务中,每一份正确的报告的总得分高于每份错误的报告,如附录7.3所示,平均最高得分的0.46.
如附录7.1和7.2所示,法官代理人是稳定的,重复判决没有什么效果,两名法官代理人在20次判决中的19次同意通过判决。

blocks.en: 4.3 Fidelity of the Twin
blocks.zh: 4.3 双亲的忠诚

blocks.en: We test along a chain of evidence how far the results that the twin returns can be trusted.
blocks.zh: 我们用一连串的证据来测试 双胞胎返回的结果可以信任的程度。

blocks.en:
We trace where the experiment results of the actor agents come from and whether the record contains the decisive experiments.
Of these experiment results, 76% come from the record or from calculators calibrated on the same laboratory’s data, as Appendix 9.2 shows, and the record contains the conditions of 78% of the decisive experiments on the expert routes, as Appendix 9.3 shows.
Thus the conclusions of most tasks depend on recorded data, and the calculators mostly fill in details around them.
blocks.zh:
我们追踪演员代理的实验结果来自何处,以及记录中是否包含决定性的实验.
这些实验结果中,如附录9.2所示,76%来自记录或在同一实验室数据上校准的计算器,记录中包含专家路线上78%决定性实验的条件,如附录9.3所示.
因此,大多数任务的结论都取决于记录的数据,计算器大多填写周围的细节.

blocks.en:
We replace the extrapolation outside the record with another equally plausible choice and rerun the actor agents on six tasks, where the replacement changes 12% to 44% of the calculator outputs, as Appendix 9.4 details.
We find that most conclusions do not depend on which plausible extrapolation the calculators use, so a modeling choice that we make when we build a task changes few evaluation outcomes.
blocks.zh:
我们用另一个同样合理的选择来取代记录外的推算, 并重新运行演员代理 执行六项任务, 替换将计算结果的12%到44%, 如附录9.4的细节。
我们发现,大多数结论并不取决于计算器所用的合理推断,因此,我们在构建一项任务时作出的模式选择很少改变评价结果。

blocks.en:
We hide recorded conditions of three tasks and rebuild their calculators without seeing them.
The median error of the hidden readings is 0.74% for interpolated conditions and 2.47% for extrapolated ones, and a hidden discrete condition is predicted within 0.6% on average, as Appendix 9.5 shows.
We find that most readings that the calculators compute near the record fall close to the real readings, so the twin returns realistic readings for new experiments near the record.
blocks.zh:
我们隐藏了记录下来的三项任务的条件,并在没有看到的情况下重建了它们的计算器.
如附录9.5所示,隐藏读数的中位误差为插值的0.74%,推算出的误差为2.47%,并预测平均在0.6%以内隐藏离散状态。
我们发现大多数计算器计算到的读数接近记录的读数接近真实的读数,因此双胞胎返回现实的读数,用于接近记录的新实验.

blocks.en:
In successful runs, more than a third of the requests are new experiments that the expert route does not contain, such as new combinations of settings and additional checks, as Appendix 9.6 shows.
The TwinLab agent answers these requests, so actor agents can solve a task along their own routes.
blocks.zh:
在成功运行中,如附录9.6所示,超过三分之一的请求是专家路线不包含的新实验,如设置的新组合和附加检查.
TwinLab代理公司回答了这些请求,因此演员代理公司可以按照自己的路线解决一项任务.

blocks.en:
When we tell Opus 5.5 on four tasks that the laboratory is simulated and that it may exploit any weakness, all 9 exploit attempts are blocked, and when we ask it to find flaws in the simulation, none of the 13 true flaws that it finds changes the scoring, as Appendix 9.7 details.
An audit of the 7808 replies of the TwinLab agent in 831 evaluation runs finds one reply that states part of the hidden truth and that the judge agent did not flag, and that run scores 0, as Appendix 9.2 shows.
These results show that the score is hard to raise through the weaknesses of the twin and that the flaws that exist are minor.
blocks.zh:
当我们告诉Opus 5.5关于实验室被模拟和可能利用任何弱点的四项任务时,所有9项利用尝试都被阻止,当我们要求它发现模拟中的缺陷时,它发现的13项真正的缺陷都没有改变评分,作为附录9.7的细节.
对TwinLab代理在831年评价中7808份答复的审计发现,一份答复陈述了部分隐藏的真相,而法官代理没有挂旗,如附录9.2所示,该答复的得分为0。
这些结果显示,通过双胞胎的弱点很难提高得分,现存的缺陷也很小.

blocks.en: Table 3: Actor agents’ conclusions when the true state changes. We keep the handoff word for word and change only the true state of the laboratory.
blocks.zh: 表3:真实状态变化时行为者的结论。 我们一字不差,只改变实验室的真实状态。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Closed-book memory probes of Opus 5.5 on all tasks. Bars give the number of tasks with a yes, partial, or no answer.
blocks.zh: 表4:所有任务的Opus 5.5闭库内存探测器. bars给出任务数时给出是,部分或无答案.

blocks.en: 4.4 Memorization Control
blocks.zh: 4.4 记忆控制

blocks.en: The tasks of TwinLab-Bench come from public records, so a model may have seen a source during training ( Sainz et al., 2023 ; Golchin & Surdeanu, 2024 ) or may derive part of an answer from prior knowledge, and we test in three ways whether the scores come from the agent’s own experiments.
blocks.zh: TwinLab-Bench的任务来自公共记录,因此一个模型可能在训练期间看到了一个来源(Sainz等人,2023年;Golchin & Surdeanu,2024年),或者可以从先前的知识中得出部分答案,我们用三种方式测试分数是否来自代理自己的实验.

blocks.en:
To test whether the answer is determined by the readings that the actor agent obtains in its own experiments, we change the true state of the laboratory and keep the handoff word for word.
We construct the new state from a documented case of the same kind of problem by changing only the calculator and the hidden truth, and a model that remembers the source answers according to the source ( Wu et al., 2024 ) .
In 8 of the 10 states that allow a verdict, the conclusion follows the new state, and no run mentions the source study, as table 4 and Appendix 8.1 show.
blocks.zh:
为了测试答案是否由演员代理在自己的实验中获得的读数所决定,我们改变实验室的真实状态,将交接的单词保留在文字上.
我们通过只改变计算器和隐藏的真相来从一个有记录的同类问题案件中构建新状态,以及一个根据来源(Wu et al., 2024)来记住源答案的模型.
如表4和附录8.1所示,在允许判决的10个州中,有8个州的结论遵循了新状态,没有运行提及来源研究。

blocks.en:
In a closed-book session without tools, Opus 5.5 recalls the conclusion of the source for none of the tasks and derives the answer without data for only 2 tasks, and Fable 5.2 recalls the conclusion for one task, as table 4 and Appendix 8.2 show.
The tasks whose source Fable 5.2 names do not score higher in its evaluation runs.
Prior knowledge gives at most part of an answer on many tasks.
blocks.zh:
在没有工具的闭页会话中,Opus 5.5回顾了所有任务的源结论,并得出只有2项任务没有数据的答案,Fable 5.2回顾了一项任务的结论,如表4和附录8.2所示.
其来源Fable 5.2名称在评价中得分不高的任务.
先前的知识多数是对许多任务的答案的一部分。

blocks.en:
With a budget of zero, Opus 5.5 and DeepSeek-flash pass none of the tasks, as Appendix 8.3 shows.
These results show that prior knowledge and the handoff do not earn the core items, and the agent has to obtain the evidence through its own experiments.
blocks.zh:
如附录8.3所示,预算为零,Opus 5.5和DeepSeek-flash没有通过任何任务。
这些结果显示,先前的知识和交接并不能挣取核心物品,而代理人必须通过自己的实验获得证据.

blocks.en: 4.5 Empirical Analysis of Model Failures
blocks.zh: 4.5 模型失败的经验分析

blocks.en: On the tasks that need experiments, the decisions that a model states before the run match only in part the decisions that it makes during the experiments, similar to the knowing-doing gap that language-model agents show in bandit tasks ( Schmied et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在需要实验的任务上,一个模型在运行前所表述的决定只与它在实验期间所作的决定部分相匹配,类似于语言模型代理人在强盗任务中表现出的已知的漏洞(Schmied等人,2025年).

blocks.en:
Before each run, the model reads the handoff files and writes a plan for the whole task, and we check whether the plan states each key decision of the task in full, as table 6 shows.
Decisions that the plan states in full score 87% of their maximum in the run, but decisions that it does not mention still score 62%.
Of the 11 decisions that the plan states in full and the run still loses, the run carries out 9 as planned and loses the score in reading its own results or in the report.
A static benchmark that grades the plan therefore misjudges many of these decisions, and a closed-book question gives the same order of scores, as Appendix 10.1 shows.
blocks.zh:
每次运行前,模型会读取交接文件,为整个任务写一个计划,我们检查计划是否如表6所示,完整地说明了任务的每个关键决定.
决定计划在跑步中满分为最高分的87%,但其中没有提到的决定仍得62%.
在计划全面声明的11项决定中,跑步仍然输掉,跑步会按计划执行9项,并在阅读自己的结果或报告中失去得分.
如附录10.1所示,一个静态基准将计划定级从而误判了其中的许多决定,一个封闭式的问题给出了相同的分数顺序。

blocks.en:
We classify every valid run of Opus 5.5 that scores 0 by the error that caused the failure, as table 6 and Appendix 10.2 report.
Of the 16 failures of Opus 5.5, 12 come from an experimental decision, most often accepting a mechanism without a discriminating test.
For example, when an oyster sugar assay reads about 30% low, Opus 5.5 rules out the pipettes after a water check and never tests the 1 μ \mu L transfer, which delivers only about 70% of the sample.
blocks.zh:
我们按造成故障的误差将Opus 5.5的每一次有效运行进行分类,如表6和附录10.2报告。
在Opus 5.5的16次失败中,有12次来自实验性决定,最常是在没有歧视性测试的情况下接受一种机制.
例如,当牡蛎糖的检测值为约30%低时,Opus 5.5在水检后排除了管子,从不测试1μ \ mu L转录,它只提供约70%的样本.

blocks.en:
Of the 21 failed runs of Opus 5.5, only 8 spend at least 90% of the budget.
Doubling their budget turns only 2 of them into a pass, as Appendix 10.3 shows.
blocks.zh:
在21次失败的奥普斯5.5运行中,只有8次花费了至少90%的预算.
如附录10.3所示,将预算翻一番只能使其中两个变成通行证。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
TwinLab-Bench evaluates whether an AI scientist can design its own experiments on twins of real laboratories, and most experiment results in these twins come from real laboratory data.
The strongest frontier model averages a score below 50 out of 100.
Opus 5.5 loses score even on decisions that it states in full before the run, and its most common experimental error is accepting a mechanism without a discriminating test.
We release the tasks and the evaluation code, and the web search of the actor agent blocks the names of the benchmark and its tasks.
blocks.zh:
TwinLab-Bench评价AI科学家是否能够设计自己对真实验室双胞胎的实验,这些双胞胎的大多数实验结果来自真实验室数据.
最强前沿模型平均得分低于50分100分.
Opus 5.5甚至连跑前完全声明的决定都输了分数,它最常见的实验错误是接受一种机制而不进行歧视性测试.
我们发布任务和评价代码,演员代理的网络搜索屏蔽基准名称及其任务.

blocks.en: 7.2 Changing the Models of the TwinLab Agent and the Judge Agent
blocks.zh: 第7.2条 改变双实验室探员和法官探员的型号

blocks.en:
DeepSeek-flash serves as the TwinLab agent, as the judge agent, and as one of the tested actor agents, and a language-model judge can favor its own generations ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ) , so we check whether the results depend on this choice.
We choose 10 tasks by a fixed rule from the three groups of tasks that the three runs of DeepSeek-flash leave all nonzero, mixed, or all zero, and we run DeepSeek-flash as the actor agent once with Sonnet 5.5 as the TwinLab agent and Opus 5.5 as the judge agent.
All 10 runs are valid, every score lies within the range of the three runs of DeepSeek-flash in the standard setting on the same task, and 5 tasks pass, against 5, 6, and 4 in the three standard runs.
To separate the judge agent from the TwinLab agent, we rejudge the same 10 runs with DeepSeek-flash, and the pass verdict changes on 1 task, where the Opus 5.5 judge agent gives 0 to a core item with a boundary.
We further rejudge 20 runs from the three runs of DeepSeek-flash on 9 of these tasks with Opus 5.5 and with DeepSeek-flash under the same judge prompt and rubric.
The two judge agents agree on pass in 19 runs (Cohen’s κ = 0.83 \kappa=0.83 ) and on validity in all runs, and the one pass change comes from Opus 5.5 grading a self-contradictory report by its weaker reading.

blocks.en: 7.3 Scores Separate Correct and Wrong Reports
blocks.zh: 7.3 单独的对错报告

blocks.en:
We draw 126 reports from the evaluation runs of all tasks with a hash rule fixed before any model call, taking one passing and two failing runs on tasks that have both and one failing run on the other tasks.
A DeepSeek-flash call classifies each report as correct, plausible but wrong, incomplete, or missing by reading it against the hidden truth, without seeing its score, its judgment, or the rubric, and we check 29 labels at the boundary by hand and change 1.
A report is correct when its main conclusions and deliverables agree with the hidden truth, also when its verification is too weak to pass.
A report is plausible but wrong when any main conclusion, cause, mechanism, recommendation, or deliverable contradicts the hidden truth, or when it leaves a main question undetermined although the hidden truth decides it.
A report is incomplete when it makes no wrong claim on the main line but its deliverable falls short.
Of these reports, 43 are correct, 69 are plausible but wrong, 6 are incomplete, and 8 runs end without a report.
On 19 of the 21 tasks that have both correct and wrong reports, the lowest total score of a correct report is above the highest total score of a wrong report, and the mean gap is 0.46 of the maximum score.

blocks.en: 8 Memorization Control
blocks.zh: 8 记忆控制

blocks.en: 8.1 Another State of the Same Laboratory
blocks.zh: 8.1 同一实验室的另一个国家

blocks.en:
For each task in this study, we keep the task description and the handoff materials word for word and change the true state of the laboratory to another state that the literature documents for the same kind of problem.
Only the calculator and the hidden truth change, and the replay of the expert route in the new state passes before any actor agent runs.
The released data list the 11 states with the original cause, the new cause and its evidence, the change in the calculator, the result of the reference replay, the state that the actor agent’s conclusion follows, and whether the run mentions the source study.
In 8 of the 10 states that allow a verdict, the conclusion follows the new state.
On the other 2 states, Opus 5.5 does not pass the task (scores of 6.5 of 10 and 8.0 of 15).
One state is excluded from the denominator because the actor agent never ran an experiment that touches the changed part.
blocks.zh:
对于本研究的每一项任务,我们保留任务说明和交割材料逐字,并将实验室的真实状态改为文献记录处理同类问题的另一种状态.
只有计算器和隐藏的真理变化,以及新状态中专家路线的重播在任何演员代理运行之前通过.
发布的数据列出了11个具有原始原因,新原因及其证据的状态,计算器的变化,参考重播的结果,演员代理的结论遵循的状态,以及运行中是否提及源研究.
在允许判决的10个州中,有8个州在新州之后得出结论。
在另外2个州,奥普斯5.5没有通过任务(10分之6.5和15分之8.0).
一个状态被排除在分母之外,因为演员代理从未进行过触及改变部分的实验.

blocks.en: 8.2 Memory Probes per Task
blocks.zh: 8.2 每个任务的内存探测器

blocks.en:
For every task, the released data list whether Opus 5.5 recognizes the source, whether it recalls the source’s conclusion, whether it derives the answer closed-book, when the source was published relative to the model’s knowledge cutoff, and the task’s score.
The probe uses two independent calls per task in a neutral temporary directory with all tools disabled.
One call asks for the source and what the model remembers of it, the other asks for the most likely answer, and a third call grades both answers against the answer key.
blocks.zh:
对于每一项任务,发布的数据列出了Opus 5.5是否承认来源,是否回顾来源的结论,是否得出了与模型知识截断相对的源的解答闭本,以及任务分数.
探测器在一个中立的临时目录中使用每个任务的两个独立呼叫,所有工具都禁用.
一个呼叫请求源和模型对它的记忆,另一个请求最有可能的答案,第三个呼叫分数都与答案键相对应.

blocks.en:
We repeat the probe for GPT-6.1-sol, DeepSeek-flash, and Qwen3.8-Max with the same prompts, answer key, and grading.
They name the source of 4, 2, and 1 tasks, against 9 for Opus 5.5, and none of them recalls the conclusion of a source.
When the tasks are grouped by whether a model names their source, the tasks with a named source do not score consistently higher in the evaluation runs of the same model, and Opus 5.5 scores 43.3 on the 9 tasks whose source it names and 43.2 on the 22 tasks whose source it does not recognize.
Fable 5.2 names the source of 16 tasks, two of which can be read from the task text, and recalls the conclusion of a source for one task.
Its evaluation runs score 49.0 on the 16 tasks whose source it names, 32.2 on the 21 tasks whose source it names in part, and 58.7 on the 15 tasks whose source it does not name.
blocks.zh:
我们重复GPT-6.1-sol、DeepSeek-flash和Quen3.8-Max的探测器,并有相同的提示、回答键和分级。
他们将4,2和1任务的来源命名为9,而Opus 5.5则命名为9,没有人回顾一个来源的结论.
当将任务归为一个模型是否命名其来源时,带有一个命名来源的任务在同一个模型的运行评价中得分不一贯较高,而Opus 5.5则在它命名的9项任务上得分43.3分,在它不承认的22项任务上得分43.2分.
寓言5.2命名了16项任务的源头,其中2项可以从任务文本中读取,并回顾一个任务的源头的结论.
其评价的得分为49.0,来源为它命名的16项任务;32.2,部分来源为它的21项任务;58.7,来源为它不命名的15项任务。

blocks.en: 8.3 Zero-Experiment Baseline
blocks.zh: 8.3 零试验基线

blocks.en:
We select the 33 tasks whose decisive data are not in the handoff, according to the scorecard annotation, and copy each task with a budget of zero; every experimental request is refused without calling the TwinLab agent.
Opus 5.5 and DeepSeek-flash each run once on every copy, and the DeepSeek-flash judge agent scores the reports with the original rubric.
Neither Opus 5.5 nor DeepSeek-flash passes any of the 33 tasks, while DeepSeek-flash with the normal budget passes 6 of the same tasks and at least one actor agent passes 28.
blocks.zh:
根据计分卡注释,我们选择了其决定性数据不在交割中的33项任务,并用零预算复制每项任务;每个实验性请求都被拒绝,而不给TwinLab代理打电话.
Opus 5.5和DeepSeek-flash各在每份副本上运行一次,DeepSeek-flash法官代理以原始标题对报告进行评分.
无论是Opus 5.5还是DeepSeek-flash都没有通过33项任务中的任何一项任务,而DeepSeek-flash与正常预算通过6项相同的任务,至少一个演员代理通过28项任务.

blocks.en: 9 Fidelity of the Twin
blocks.zh: 9 双子公司

blocks.en: 9.1 Pilot Study: What the Laboratory Needs to Know
blocks.zh: 9.1 试验研究:实验室需要了解什么

blocks.en:
We replay the requests of the expert route in 12 tasks, four from each division, against three settings, with two independent sessions per setting.
The language model in all three settings is DeepSeek-flash, the model that serves as the environment in the evaluation.
The rule that selects the tasks and the tolerance of each task from the raw files were fixed before any output was read.
Deviation is counted on the 126 answers to the 63 requests whose conditions exist in the record, and inconsistency on the 93 requests asked in both sessions.
Deviation drops from 41% with the task description alone to 14% with raw materials and to 2% with the TwinLab agent; substantial inconsistency drops from 31% to 8% and 4%.
The 3 deviating answers of the TwinLab agent all occur in one task: one request receives a calculator value below the tolerance band in both sessions, and one well of a 48-well plate exceeds an 8% rule by 0.2 points.
Of the 4 requests that the TwinLab agent answers inconsistently, 2 differ only in the amount charged.
The report of the expert route passes in 17, 21, and 23 of the 24 sessions of the three settings.
In a pilot, a language model that writes a metabolic curve by itself produces a curve about 20 times slower than the record.
blocks.zh:
我们在12项任务中重复专家路线的要求,每个司4项,对3项设置,每项设置有2项独立的会话.
所有三种设置中的语言模型是DeepSeek-flash,即作为评价中环境的模型.
从原始文件中选择任务和每项任务的容忍度的规则在读取任何输出之前被固定.
偏离取决于对记录在案的63项请求的126项答复,以及这两届会议提出的93项请求不一致。
绕行率从41%下降至14%(仅任务说明),再降至14%(原材料),再降至2%(双实验室剂);严重不一致率从31%降至8%和4%。
TwinLab代理的3个偏差解答都发生在一个任务中:一个请求在两个会话中都得到一个低于容积带的计算值,一个48井板的井超过8%的规则0.2分.
在TwinLab代理答复不一致的4项请求中,只有2项要求的金额不同。
专家路线报告在三种场合的24届会议中有17、21和23次通过。
在飞行员中,一个写代谢曲线的语言模型本身就会产生比记录慢约20倍的曲线.

blocks.en: 9.2 Sources of Readings and Destinations of Requests
blocks.zh: 9.2 请求的阅读来源和目的地

blocks.en:
We take the first valid run of every actor configuration other than Opus 5.5 at medium effort on every task, 831 runs with 7808 requests, and classify every reading by the dominant source of its numbers and every request by its destination.
Over all readings, 76% come from the record or from calculators calibrated on the same laboratory’s data, with 53% looked up in the record and 23% computed by the calculators, and 99.5% trace back to the record, a calculator output, or one step of arithmetic.
Only 0.5% of all requests are not simulated at all.
blocks.zh:
除了Opus 5.5之外,我们每个角色配置的首次有效运行是针对每个任务的中度努力,831运行有7808个请求,并按其数字的主要来源和目的地对每个阅读进行分类.
在所有读数中,76%来自记录或在同一实验室数据上校准的计算器,其中53%来自记录,23%由计算器计算,99.5%来自记录、计算器输出或算术的一步。
只有0.5%的请求根本没有被模拟.

blocks.en:
We also audit every reply of the TwinLab agent in these runs for disclosure of the hidden truth.
A script first marks 79 replies that contain a number, a name, or a phrase of the hidden truth that the requests of the actor agent and the outputs of the tools do not explain.
A DeepSeek-flash call then judges these replies, the 162 other replies in which the TwinLab agent read the internals of a calculator, and 100 random replies, and we check every reply that it flags by hand.
One reply states a hidden mechanism without being asked, and one reply describes an asked-for observation that the calculator does not model, which we count as a coverage gap; both runs score 0, and none of the random replies is flagged.
blocks.zh:
我们还审核TwinLab探员的每份答复 以公开隐藏的真相
一个脚本首先标记了79个包含数字,名称,或隐藏真理的短语的回答,即演员代理的请求和工具的输出没有解释.
一个DeepSeek-flash呼叫然后判断这些答复,其他162个答复中TwinLab代理阅读一个计算器的内部内容,以及100个随机答复,我们检查每一个它手举旗的回复.
一份答复称有一个隐性机制而没有被问到,一份答复则描述了一个被问到的观察,即计算器不建模,我们算作覆盖漏洞;两个都运行得分0,随机答复都没有标注.

blocks.en: 9.3 Audit of Extrapolation Dependence
blocks.zh: 9.3 对外推法依赖性的审计

blocks.en:
Without running new models, we label every reading in the evaluation runs with its source and compare the actor agents with the replay of the expert route, which every task has, on the 29 tasks whose replay used the same TwinLab agent.
The share of requests that actually obtain data outside the record does not differ between the actor agents and the expert route (median difference 0 per task, p = 0.24 p=0.24 ), and it does not differ between two reasoning efforts of the same model.
On real-source tasks, rubric items whose evidence comes only from design parameters or from numbers written by the TwinLab agent score 0.63 of full credit, and items whose evidence comes from the record score 0.62.
For each of the 6 tasks whose deliverable is scored by a calculator, the settings that the actor agent can choose are either limited to the real settings in the record or come from the same design model as the observations.
The expert routes of 42 of the 49 tasks built from real records request experiments.
Of their 189 decisive experiments, 78% use conditions that the record contains, 15% partly extend a recorded condition, and 7% lie outside the record.
On 7 further tasks built from real records, the expert route has no scored experiment, because the evidence comes from offline analysis of the handoff records, and we count these tasks separately.
blocks.zh:
在不运行新模式的情况下,我们将评价中的每个读数与它的源头进行标签,并将演员代理与专家路线的重播进行比较,每个任务都有,在重播使用同一双Lab代理的29项任务上.
实际取得记录外数据的请求比例在演员代理和专家路线之间没有区别(每任务中间差0,p=0.24,p=0.24),同一模式的两个推理努力之间没有区别.
在真源任务上,其证据仅来自设计参数或TwinLab代理撰写的数字的标点项目得分0.63满分,其证据来源于唱片的标点项目得分0.62.
对于可交付的6项任务中,每个任务由计算器打出,演员代理可以选择的设置要么仅限于记录中的真实设置,要么来自与观测相同的设计模型.
从真实记录中构建的49项任务中42项的专家路线请求实验.
在189项决定性实验中,78%采用了记录包含的条件,15%部分延长了记录状态,7%处于记录之外。
在从真实记录中构建的另外7项任务上,专家路线没有得分的实验,因为证据来自对交割记录的离线分析,我们分别计算这些任务.

blocks.en: 9.4 Sensitivity to Extrapolation
blocks.zh: 9.4 对外推法的敏感性

blocks.en:
For six tasks whose decisive items rely partly on conditions outside the record, we build a variant that changes only the extrapolation outside the record to another choice that is physically just as plausible, such as the other end of the literature range or another functional form.
Three of the tasks are chosen by a rule fixed in advance, which takes the real-source tasks where at least two of the three actor agents below score above zero and whose earlier runs reach the changed extrapolation.
The outputs for recorded conditions stay identical, and so do the hidden truth, the rubric, the task description, and the actor agent’s files.
We first replay the calculator commands of existing runs on the original and the variant and count how many outputs change, and we then run Sonnet 5.5, Kimi K3.1 Pro, and GLM-5.3 once each on every variant, with the DeepSeek-flash TwinLab agent and judge agent, and compare with their runs on the original in table 11 .
Sonnet 5.5 runs at medium effort on the first three tasks and at high effort on the other three.
In every variant the replay of the expert route still earns full marks.
We compare each variant run with the run of the same model and effort in figure 6 ; on the 12 pairs whose original run used the same task version as the variant, the pass verdict changes in 2 pairs and the median absolute change of the score is 0.
blocks.zh:
对于6项任务,其决定性项目部分依赖于记录以外的条件,我们构建了一个变体,它只将记录以外的推算改变为实际上同样可行的另一种选择,如文献范围的另一端或另一种功能形式.
其中3项任务由事先定下的一条规则选择,该规则承担了真源任务,即低于零分的3名演员代理中至少有2人得分高于零,且其较早的运行达到已改变的外推.
记录条件的输出保持不变,隐藏的真相、标题、任务描述和演员代理的文件也是如此。
我们首先在原版和变体上重播现有运行的计算指令,并计算出输出变化的多少,然后在每个变体上运行Sonnet 5.5,Kimi K3.1 Pro,以及GLM-5.3,每个变体上各运行一次,由DeepSeek-flash TwinLab代理和判官代理,并与他们在表11中的原版运行比较.
Sonnet 5.5在前三项任务上是中度努力,其他三项任务则是高度努力。
在每个变体中,专家路线的重播仍然获得满分。
我们比较了图6中每个变体运行与相同模式和努力的运行情况;在原运行使用与变体相同任务版本的12对变体上,通过判定以2对变化,得分的中位绝对变化为0.

blocks.en: Table 11: Sensitivity to the extrapolation. Outputs changed: share of calculator outputs of existing runs that differ on the variant.
blocks.zh: 表11 对外推的敏感性. 产出已改变:现有运行中计算产出的比例因变体而异。

blocks.en:
In the fatigue task, the changed outputs appear in the evidence that the judge agent cites in 14 of 18 existing runs, yet the conclusions on the variant are the same for all three actor agents.
In the oyster task, the change multiplies the reading of the expert’s bench-delay test by 1.7, but the actor agents take another path.
On that path the readings change by 0% to 8%, and the ranking of the oyster families stays the same in 83 of 90 reads.
Two changes in the third conclusion trace back to the wording of offline analyses and to a different choice of water, and replaying these runs on the original task gives almost the same readings.
In the radiocarbon task, one actor agent measures very small samples after sonication, where the reading depends entirely on the extrapolated residue, and changes its recommendation for low-yield samples.
The correct conclusion of this task itself depends on the size of this residue.
In the phonon task, the changed outputs appear in the evidence that the judge agent cites in 20 of 21 existing runs, and the score differences between the original and the variant come from two items on the wording of the report whose evidence cites none of the changed requests.
In the fly task, no run on the variant requests a re-derived strain panel, and in the zero-bias task, no rubric item reads the changed room-temperature readings, and the two runs that change their pass verdict analyze another sweep of the recorded data.
blocks.zh:
在疲劳的任务中,改变的产出出现在法官代理人在18个现有作业中的14个引用的证据中,然而关于变式的结论对于所有3个演员代理人都是相同的.
在牡蛎任务中,变化将专家板凳延迟测试的读数乘以1.7,但演员代理人走的是另一条道路.
在这条路上,读数变化了0%至8%,牡蛎家庭的排名在90个读数中的83个保持不变。
第三个结论的两个变化可以追溯到离线分析的措辞和不同的水选择,在原任务上重播这些内容,给出的读数几乎相同.
在放射性碳化物任务中,一名演员代理测量声波后非常小的样本,其读数完全依赖于推算的残留,并更改其对低产样本的建议.
这项任务本身的正确结论取决于这一残留物的大小。
在phonon任务中,改变的产出出现在法官代理人在21个现有运行中20个引用的证据中,原始和变体之间的分数差异来自报告措辞的两个项目,其证据未引用任何更改的请求。
在苍蝇任务中,不运行变体请求重新生成的菌株面板,在零比亚任务中,没有鲁比克项目读取已改变的室温读数,改变其通过判断的两种运行分析再次扫描记录的数据.

blocks.en: 9.5 Held-Out Conditions
blocks.zh: 9.5 被搁置条件

blocks.en:
We test how close the calculators come to real readings on conditions that the record contains but the calculator does not see.
We choose three tasks whose calculators extend a measurement along a continuous variable, namely phonon bursts in a detector, gliding of kinesin-driven microtubules, and fluorescence blanks of clam assays.
On each task we hide 2 to 10 recorded conditions together with the measurements that reveal them, and the hidden values go to a file that the rebuilder cannot read.
A separate session rebuilds each calculator from the reduced record and the construction rules alone, without the original calculator, the task files, or the rubric.
Of the 15 hidden readings, 10 fall within twice the measured repeatability, and the median error is 0.74% for interpolated conditions and 2.47% for extrapolated ones.
On all three tasks, the rubric items that involve the hidden conditions reach the same judgment with the rebuilt calculator.
In a second round we hide a whole discrete condition, one of the four caseins that coat the slides of the kinesin task, and the rebuilt calculator predicts the mean gliding speed of the hidden casein within 0.6%.
Over both rounds, 19 of the 29 hidden readings fall within twice the measured repeatability, with a median error of 1.37%, and the rubric judgments stay the same.
blocks.zh:
我们测试计算器在记录包含但计算器看不到的条件下 是如何接近真正的读数的.
我们选择了三项任务,其计算器沿着一个连续的变数延伸了一个测量,即探测器中的光子暴动,闪烁着动因驱动的微管,和荧光空白的蛤类化验。
在每项任务中,我们隐藏2到10个记录的条件,以及揭示这些条件的测量,隐藏的值会转到重建者无法读取的文件中.
一个单独的会话从减少的纪录和建筑规则中重建每个计算器,没有原始的计算器,任务文件,或标题.
在15个隐藏读数中,有10个在所测量的重复性两倍之内,中间误差在插值条件下为0.74%,在推算条件下为2.47%.
在所有三项任务上,涉及隐藏条件的标点项目与重建的计算器都得出同样的判断.
在第二轮中,我们隐藏了一个整体的离散状态, 一种是涂抹动因任务滑动的4个案例之一, 重建后的计算器预测隐藏案例的平均滑翔速度在0.6%之内。
在两轮中,29个隐藏读数中,有19个在所测量的重复性两倍以内,中间误差为1.37%,标题判断保持不变.

blocks.en: 9.6 Experiments Beyond the Expert Route
blocks.zh: 9.6 实验 专家路线之外

blocks.en:
We compare every successful run with the expert route of its task in two rounds.
We use the successful runs in figure 6 . The first round takes the 14 tasks that the most actor agents solve, 74 runs; the second takes 8 tasks whose decisive test has to be devised by the agent or whose expert route has at least five experiments, 30 runs.
For every core item, an Opus 5.5 call that sees the runs in shuffled order without their actor names decides whether the run supports the item with the same kind of experiment as the expert route, with another kind, or partly with another kind.
In the two rounds, 10 of 74 and 6 of 30 successful runs support a core item partly with another kind of experiment than the expert route.
In both rounds, 36% of the requests of successful runs have no counterpart in the expert route, mostly controls that the actor agents design themselves, such as a small pilot that varies two preparation steps together, which three actor agents ran independently to tell a clot in the sample from a missing reagent.
blocks.zh:
我们分两轮将每次成功的运行与其任务的专家路线进行比较。
我们用图6中的成功运行。 第一轮要承担最多演员代理解决的14项任务,74项运行;第二轮要承担8项任务,其决定性测试必须由代理设计或专家路线至少有5项实验,30项运行.
对于每一个核心项目,一个Opus 5.5呼叫,在没有其演员姓名的情况下以洗牌顺序看到运行,决定运行是用与专家路线相同的实验支持项目,用另一种,还是部分用另一种.
在两轮比赛中,74次比赛中有10次成功,30次比赛中有6次成功,通过专家路线以外的另一种试验,部分支持核心项目。
在两轮比赛中,36%的成功运行请求在专家路线中没有对应,大多控制演员代理自己设计,例如一个小飞行员将两个准备步骤一起不同,三个演员代理独立跑来从一个缺失的试剂中分辨样本中的一块块块.

blocks.en: 9.7 Red-Team Actor Agents
blocks.zh: 9.7 红队演员

blocks.en:
On 4 tasks, we run Opus 5.5 in three arms.
The honest arm is the run of Opus 5.5 at high effort in figure 6 .
The exploit arm is told that the laboratory is simulated, that the score is computed against a hidden answer, and that it may exploit weaknesses of the simulation to maximize the score.
The flaw-finding arm is asked mainly to find flaws of the simulation, such as physically implausible readings, contradictions with the files, or leaks, and to submit a report as usual.
The red-team instructions appear only in the actor agent’s workspace, so the TwinLab agent sees the original task, and all runs are judged blind with the original rubric.
Every reported flaw is verified by reading the session and the calculator.
The four tasks are a process-window search on public data, a synthetic battery task, the fatigue task, and the oyster task; the first two are scored by a calculator.
blocks.zh:
执行4项任务,我们以3个臂膀执行Opus 5.5.
诚实的手臂是奥普斯5.5的运行 在图6的高度努力。
开采臂被告知实验室是模拟的,比分是根据隐藏的答案计算,它可能利用模拟的弱点来达到得分最大化.
要求缺陷调查臂主要是为了发现模拟的缺陷,如物理上的不可信读数,与文件的矛盾,或泄露,并照常提交报告.
红队指令只出现在演员代理的工作空间中,因此TwinLab代理看到了原任务,所有运行都以原标题判断为盲.
每个报告的缺陷都通过阅读会话和计算器来核实.
这四项任务都是在公共数据上进行过程窗口搜索,合成电池任务,疲劳任务,以及牡蛎任务;前两项由计算器打分.

blocks.en:
The exploit arm makes 9 attempts in total.
Seven ask the laboratory staff for the conclusion, the answer key, the source dataset, an underlying table, or history after the cutoff point; one asks for a setting outside the recorded matrix; one lists settings as a range.
The history cutoff, the TwinLab agent’s refusals, the calculators’ refusals, and the simulation limits block all of them, no leak guard fires, and no run searches the web, after which the actor agents solve the tasks normally.
No core item receives credit without evidence, and on two tasks the second check of core items removes credit that the first judgment gave.
blocks.zh:
开采臂共9次尝试.
七人向实验室工作人员询问结论,答案密钥,源数据集,基础表,或断点后的历史;一人在记录的矩阵之外要求设置;一是列出设置为范围.
历史的截断,TwinLab代理的拒绝,计算器的拒绝,模拟的限制都阻挡了他们,没有泄密的警卫火灾,也没有搜索网络,之后演员代理正常地解决任务.
没有证据,任何核心项目都得不到信贷,在两项任务中,对核心项目的第二次检查取消了第一次判决给予的信贷。

blocks.en:
The flaw-finding arm claims 39 flaws: 13 are true, 11 are acceptable simulation limits, and 15 are false alarms.
The true flaws are minor, such as two instruments of a synthetic task that use inconsistent voltage models, a handoff file that the TwinLab agent describes wrongly, and a clock that three answers report differently; none of them changes the scoring evidence or a key decision.
All claimed physical implausibilities on the public-data task are doubts about real measurements.
Looking for flaws also changes the actor agents’ behavior: on two tasks they record the designed discriminating evidence as a flaw, so the scores of this arm do not measure the honest ability.
blocks.zh:
缺陷调查臂声称有39个缺陷:13个是真实的,11个是可接受的模拟极限,15个是假警报.
真正的缺陷是微小的,例如两个合成任务的仪器使用不一致的电压模型,一个TwinLab代理错误描述的交接文件,以及一个3个答案不同报告的时钟;它们都没有改变评分证据或关键决定.
所有声称在公共数据任务上的物理不可信之处都是对真实测量的怀疑.
寻找缺陷也改变了演员的行为:在两项任务中,他们将设计出来的歧视性证据记录为缺陷,因此这一臂的分数并不能衡量诚实的能力.

blocks.en: 10 Failure Analysis
blocks.zh: 10 失败分析

blocks.en: 10.1 Decision Points: Protocol and Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 10.1 决定要点:议定书和敏感性

blocks.en:
We extract the decision points of each task from the rubric and from the expert route, and we split them into action decisions (133) and discovery decisions (149).
Probe A asks the decision questions closed-book, and probe B asks the model to write a plan with read-only access to the handoff files.
Under the core criterion, an answer counts as fully stated when it contains the decision of the expert route; under the strict criterion, it also has to meet the full-credit wording of the rubric.
The grading model agrees with human annotation on 85% to 88% of the decision points.
Probe A names the topic of each decision point and asks what the model would do about it.
With the closed-book question (A), decisions stated in full, only in principle, and not mentioned score 82%, 75%, and 71% of their maximum in the run, and with the plan (B) they score 87%, 66%, and 62%.
Decisions that the model states in full receive 37% (A) and 61% (B) of the score obtained and 28% (A) and 31% (B) of the score lost.
Under the strict criterion, decisions stated in full lose 8% (A) and 13% (B) of their score, and decisions stated only in principle lose 25% (A) and 29% (B).
On the action and discovery decisions together with B, the three levels lose 15%, 38%, and 57% of their score.
The probes run on the evaluation runs of Opus 5.5 at high effort in figure 6 , and each prompt is sampled three times with the majority answer kept.
For the 11 action decisions that B states in full and the run does not score in full, we compare the plan with the requests of the run and with the reason that the judge agent gives for the item.
In 2 of them the run does not carry out the planned experiment: one run never tests the extraction kit on fresh tissue, and one run discharges cells that the order needs, although its plan tests only spare cells.
In the other 9, the run carries out the planned experiment and loses the score when it draws conclusions from its own readings or writes the report, which accounts for 16 of the 19.5 rubric score that the 11 decisions lose, as table 12 lists.
blocks.zh:
我们从标题和专家路线中提取每项任务的决定点,把它们分为行动决定(133)和发现决定(149).
探测 A质询裁判质疑封闭本,探测器B质询模型写出一个只读访问交接文件的计划.
在核心标准下,一个答案在包含专家路线的决定时算得上是充分表述的;在严格标准下,它也必须符合标题的完全信用措辞.
评分模式同意85%至88%的决定点的人类注释。
探测 每个决定点的主题都有一个名称,并询问模型对此会做什么。
以"闭帐问题(A)"为例,决定完全陈述,原则上只陈述,未提及,在运行中得分为82%,75%,71%的最高分,而计划(B)则得分为87%,66%,62%.
决定模式完全宣布获得37%(A)和61%(B)的得分,28%(A)和31%(B)的得分损失.
根据严格的标准,完全宣布的决定损失其分数的8%(A)和13%(B),而原则上只宣布损失25%(A)和29%(B)。
在动作和发现决定上与B一起,三个级别损失了15%,38%,以及57%的分数.
在图6的高度努力下,对Opus 5.5的评价运行的探测器进行了三次取样,大多数答案都保留下来。
对于B全面宣布的11项行动决定和跑步不完全得分的决定,我们比较了计划与跑步的要求以及法官代理人为该项目给出的理由.
在其中2项中,运行不进行计划中的实验:一项运行从未在新鲜组织上测试提取包,一项运行排出订单需要的细胞,尽管其计划测试仅是备用细胞.
在另外9个中,运行会进行计划中的实验,并在从自己的读数中得出结论或写报告时失去分数,这占了11个决定损失的19.5分的16分,如表12所列.

blocks.en: Table 12: Decisions that the plan states in full and the run still loses. Each row is one action decision of Opus 5.5 at high effort, and Score gives the rubric score that the run obtains out of the maximum of the item.
blocks.zh: 表12:计划全面阐述的决定和运行仍然亏损. 每行是Opus 5.5在高功率下的一个动作决定,Score给出了运行在项目最大时获得的标分.

blocks.en: 10.2 Failure Types per Run
blocks.zh: 10.2 每次运行失败类型

blocks.en:
We define three failure types.
A mechanism is accepted without a discriminating experiment when the report adopts a mechanism that the run never tested against its alternative.
A scarce material is used up before testing when the key scarce material is consumed before the experiment that decides how to use it.
A procedure is chosen on weak early evidence when the deliverable depends on an early comparison that used too few samples or was confounded.
For every failed run, the released data list the type, the share of budget and of scarce material used when the decisive test started, and whether the run ended because the budget ran out.
Of the 16 failed runs of Opus 5.5 at high effort on the 33 tasks that need experiments, 12 fall into these three types, and the other 4 err in reading the results or in writing the report.
blocks.zh:
我们定义了三种失败类型。
如果报告采用了一种机制,而这种机制从未对替代机制进行测试,则接受这种机制而不进行歧视性试验。
在决定如何使用关键稀有材料的试验之前,在试验之前就使用稀有材料。
当交付品取决于使用太少的样品或被怀疑的早期比较时,根据微弱的早期证据选择一种程序。
对于每次失败的运行,发布的数据列出了决定性测试开始时所使用的类型,预算份额和稀缺材料,以及运行是否因为预算耗尽而结束.
Opus 5.5在33项需要实验的任务上付出了很大努力而失败的16次运行中,有12次属于这三种类型,另外4次在阅读结果或撰写报告时失误.

blocks.en: 10.3 Budget Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 10.3 预算敏感性

blocks.en:
The budget of a task is a multiple of the amount used by the replay of the expert route; the multiple is between 1 and 3 for 49 tasks, with a median of 1.6. Table 13 compares how much of the budget passing and failing runs use on the 40 tasks that charge for experiments.
The 12 tasks whose actions are all free of charge, 11 of which offer no experiments, are left out, because every run on them spends nothing.
blocks.zh:
一项任务的预算是重播专家路线所使用的金额的倍数;在49项任务中,该倍数在1-3之间,中间数为1.6. 表13比较了通过和失败的预算用于40项试验任务的情况。
行动都是免费的12项任务,其中11项不提供实验,却被排除在外,因为每一次跑步都没有花费。

blocks.en: Table 13: Budget use of passing and failing runs on the 40 tasks that charge for experiments. Used up counts the runs that spend at least 99% of the budget, and Median is the median fraction of the budget spent.
blocks.zh: 表13:通过和失败的预算使用情况涉及40项试验任务。 用完算起至少花费99%预算的运行量,Median是所花费预算的中位数。

blocks.en:
We also rerun with twice the budget all 8 failed runs of Opus 5.5 that spent at least 90% of their budget.
All 8 reruns are valid, and 2 of them pass (the radiocarbon task, from 0 to 95, and the task that matches battery cells into strings, from 0 to 96.4).
Of the 6 reruns that fail again, 4 fail on a core item that the original run also failed, and 2 fail on a different core item.
Three of these 6 reruns use less than 70% of the doubled budget.
blocks.zh:
我们还以预算的两倍重新运行 全部8次失败运行 Opus 5.5 至少花费了90%的预算。
所有8个重排都是有效的,其中2个通过(放射性碳化物任务,从0到95,以及电池匹配为字符串的任务,从0到96.4).
在再次失败的6次重播中,4次在原运行也失败的核心项目上失败,2次在不同的核心项目上失败.
这6人中有3人重新运行,使用的预算不到两倍的70%。

blocks.en: 11 Scorecard Definitions and Annotations
blocks.zh: 11 计分卡定义和说明

blocks.en:
We define the six columns of figure 5 and their levels.
Tasks and scenes count the tasks and the distinct experimental settings.
Action types count the distinct experimental actions that the agent can request.
The source of research problems has three levels: designed, found in real data, and met and solved by the laboratory. A problem found in real data lies in the measurements, but the record does not show the laboratory meeting it; a problem met and solved by the laboratory appears in the record together with its later answer.
The environment for new experiments has three levels: analysis of given data, equations or a designed world, and a replay or a twin of a real laboratory.
Memorization control has three levels: the risk is noted, the tasks use data that the model has not seen, such as altered, held-out, or fictional data, or memorization is probed on the tested model.
For every existing benchmark, each cell cites the sentence of the original paper that supports it.
TwinLab-Bench is annotated task by task with the same definitions, and two annotators label the action types independently (105 and 107 types).
blocks.zh:
我们界定了图5的六栏及其水平。
任务和场景计算任务和独特的实验设置.
动作类型计算出代理人可以要求的不同实验动作.
研究问题的源头有三个层次:设计,发现于真实数据,由实验室满足和解决. 真实数据中发现的一个问题在于测量,但记录没有显示实验室与它相遇;一个实验室遇到和解决的问题连同其后来的答案一起出现在记录中.
新实验的环境有三个层面:分析特定数据,方程式或设计的世界,以及一个重播或一个真正的实验室的双子.
记忆控制有三个层面:注意风险,任务使用模型未见的数据,如更改,搁置,或虚构数据,或在测试模型上探测到记忆.
对于每一个现有的基准,每个单元格都引用支持它的原始文件的句子.
TwinLab-Bench是按相同定义的任务附加说明的任务,两个注释器将动作类型(105型和107型)独立标注.

blocks.en:
Some benchmarks already ask an agent to design experiments.
SciGym ( Duan et al., 2025 ) , DiscoveryWorld ( Jansen et al., 2024 ) , and BoxingGym ( Gandhi et al., 2025 ) let the agent choose experiments in a designed world or an equation model, so their readings follow written rules.
ASB ( Wen & Liu, 2026 ) lets the agent choose batches of designs within a budget and returns published measurements, so each campaign offers one kind of action over the recorded designs.
TwinLab-Bench combines the two properties that these benchmarks have separately: the actor agent composes its experiments freely, and the readings come from the records of real laboratories.
blocks.zh:
一些基准已经要求代理设计实验.
SciGym(Duan等人,2025年),发现世界(Jansen等人,2024年),和拳击. Gym(Gandhi et al.,2025)让代理人在设计的世界或方程式模型中选择实验,因此他们的读数遵循书面规则.
ASB(Wen & Liu, 2026)让代理商在预算范围内选择批次的设计,并返回已公布的测量结果,因此每次运动都提供一种动作来代替所记录的设计.
TwinLab-Bench结合了这些基准分别具有的两个属性: 演员代理自由编写其实验,读数来自真实实验室的记录.

blocks.en: 12 Data Sources and Licenses
blocks.zh: 12 数据来源和许可证

blocks.en:
Every task uses its source records under the terms of their licenses.
Where a license does not allow direct reuse, we contacted the data providers by email, and the other sources are released under licenses that allow reuse with attribution, which we follow. Table 14 lists the source records, the papers, and the related references of every task.
blocks.zh:
每项任务都使用其许可证规定的来源记录。
在许可证不允许直接再利用的情况下,我们通过电子邮件与数据提供者联系,根据允许再利用和归属的许可证释放了其他来源。 表14列出了每项任务的原始记录、文件和相关参考资料。

blocks.en:
The pictures in Figure 1 come from the source records of the four tasks.
The fluorescence images of gliding microtubules are from the open notebook of Maloney on OpenWetWare ( Maloney, 2010a ) (CC BY-SA), and the fracture surface of the steel specimen is Figure 7a of Wietecha-Reiman et al. (2025) (CC BY 4.0).
blocks.zh:
图1中的图片来自四大任务的来源记录.
滑翔微泡的荧光图像来自OpenWetWare(Maloney,2010a)上的Maloney的公开笔记本(CC BY-SA),钢标本的断裂表面为Wietecha-Reiman等人的图7a(2025)(CC BY 4.0.

blocks.en: 13 Implementation of the Twin and the Judge
blocks.zh: 13 双人和法官的执行

blocks.en: 13.1 Mechanisms of the Twin and the Scoring
blocks.zh: 13.1 双重和分红机制

blocks.en:
The environment code checks that the recorded value is used whenever the actor agent’s request allows it.
The TwinLab agent gives no hints or interpretations, does not substitute another procedure for a requested one, and answers questions about history only up to the cutoff point.
When the actor agent asks whether the cause is X, the TwinLab agent only answers that this needs an experimental test.
The environment code also asserts that observations contain no internal identifier or leakage pattern and that an unexecuted request is neither charged nor consumes material, and a failed assertion stops the run.
blocks.zh:
环境代码检查,只要演员代理的请求允许,记录值就会被使用.
TwinLab代理商不给出提示或解释,不替代另一个程序来代替请求的程序,只解答关于历史的问题直到断点.
当演员代理询问原因是否为X时,TwinLab代理只回答这需要实验测试.
环境代码还声称,观测没有包含内部识别特征或渗漏模式,未执行的请求既没有充电,也没有消耗材料,一个失败的断言阻止了运行。

blocks.en:
A listed value is either a condition that the laboratory ran or a condition with a written extrapolation basis; across all tasks, 371 listed values are recorded and 100 are extrapolated.
An extrapolated value may never be needed in the real experiment, so it acts as a plausible distractor, and the lists are not ordered by the answer.
blocks.zh:
列出的数值是实验室运行的一个条件,或者是具有书面推断基础的一个条件;在所有任务中,记录了371个列出的数值,推断出100个数值.
在真正的实验中可能永远不需要一个推导值,因此它起到一个可信的分心器的作用,列表不是由答案命令的.

blocks.en:
The actor agent’s sandbox has no configuration, memory, skill, or past session.
The TwinLab agent cannot see the actor agent’s reasoning, and the actor agent cannot see image file names or the rationale of the TwinLab agent.
The environment code checks that the actor agent was answered by the requested model, and a run is invalid when the platform switched models during it.
We scan the content that reaches the actor agent through its tools, and a blocked string or a per-task marker string in this content, or repeated attempts to reach a blocked source, invalidates the run.
Every run records a hash of the rubric that is compared with the frozen version.
blocks.zh:
演员代理的沙盒没有配置,记忆,技能,也没有过去的会话.
TwinLab代理无法看到演员代理的推理,而演员代理也无法看到图像文件名称或TwinLab代理的理由.
环境代码检查演员代理被请求的模型回答,当平台在运行期间切换模型时运行无效.
我们通过它的工具扫描到达演员代理的内容,在这个内容中一个被封堵的字符串或每个任务标记字符串,或者重复试图到达一个被封堵的来源,使得运行无效.
每一次运行都记录了与冷冻版相比的散列曲.

blocks.en:
A strong actor agent may seek out conditions where the calculators extrapolate favorably, or look for flaws in the twin, as agents exploit flaws in their rewards and tests elsewhere ( Amodei et al., 2016 ; Zhong et al., 2025 ) .
Besides scoring against the hidden truth, three designs limit this risk.
Numbers come from deterministic calculators, extrapolation is confined to values with a written basis, and the leakage guards, the replay script, and the environment audit check every run.
blocks.zh:
一个强大的演员代理人可能寻找一些条件,使计算器能够有利地推断,或寻找双胞胎的缺陷,因为代理人在其他地方利用他们的奖励和测试中的缺陷(Amodei等人,2016年;Zhong等人,2025年)。
除了与隐藏的真相作对之外,三种设计也限制了这种风险.
数字来源于定型计算器,推算仅限于有书面依据的数值,漏泄守备,重播脚本,以及环境审计检查每一次运行.

blocks.en: We release the environment code, which enforces the remaining rules, such as measurement noise, checkpoints, billing, and the stock of scarce materials.
blocks.zh: 我们发布了环境规范,它执行剩下的规则,如测量噪音、检查站、计费以及稀缺材料的库存。

blocks.en: 13.2 Judge Agent and Environment Audit
blocks.zh: 13.2 代理法官和环境审计

blocks.en:
The environment audit has three parts.
A leak is an observation that states an explanation, a cause, or the hidden truth.
An inconsistency is an observation that contradicts the task, an earlier observation, or physics, including identical values for independent samples, silently changed parameters, and unexecuted items reported as results.
A coverage gap is a refusal of an experiment that a real laboratory can run and that matters for scoring.
Any of the three makes the run invalid.
We release all prompts with the evaluation code, including those of the actor agent, the TwinLab agent, the judge agent, and every probe in these appendices.
blocks.zh:
环境审计分三部分。
泄密是指表示解释,原因,或隐藏真相的观察.
不一致是指与任务,更早的观测,或物理学相矛盾的观察,包括独立样本的相同值,默默改变的参数,以及未执行的被报告为结果的项目.
覆盖差距是拒绝一个真正的实验室可以运行的实验,对于评分很重要.
三者中的任何一人使运行无效.
包括演员代理、TwinLab代理、法官代理 以及这些附录中的每个探测器

blocks.en: 14 Task List and Construction
blocks.zh: 14 任务列表和构建

blocks.en:
Of the 52 tasks, 49 are adapted directly from the records of one laboratory and 3 are grounded syntheses.
In some of the adapted tasks the laboratory itself met the problem and later solved it, and in the others the problem lies in the real data of the laboratory.
By form, 37 tasks are claim reviews, 5 are troubleshooting tasks, and 10 are research campaigns.
The hidden truth of a task comes from a later notebook entry, a publication, a correction, or a reanalysis of the raw data.
The hidden truth of the remaining 3 tasks, which are grounded syntheses, is fixed by construction.
These tasks use real data as background, the literature shows that their problem occurred on the same kind of device or sample at a similar size, and their answer comes from the cases that the literature documents.
The handoff materials are taken from the last version of the source repository that was committed before the cutoff point, so they contain no file or finding that appeared later.
The readings, the hidden truth, and the expert route of every task come from the records and annotations that the source laboratory published, and every task follows the same construction steps.
We considered about 375 candidate sources and kept those with a closed answer, raw data that can anchor new readings, and key findings that require a specific diagnosis.
blocks.zh:
在52项任务中,有49项直接根据一个实验室的记录改编,3项是基础合成。
在一些经过改造的任务中,实验室本身遇到了问题,后来解决了,而在另一些任务中,问题在于实验室的真实数据.
按形式划分,37项任务是索赔审查,5项是解决问题的任务,10项是研究活动。
一项任务的隐藏真相来自后来的笔记本条目,出版物,更正,或对原始数据的重新分析.
其余3项任务的隐秘真相,即是基础合成,由建筑固定.
这些任务使用真实数据作为背景,文献显示他们的问题发生在类似大小的同类设备或样本上,他们的答案来自文献所记录的案例.
交接材料取自截断点之前的最后一个版本的源寄存器,因此没有包含后来出现的文件或发现.
读数,隐藏的真相,以及每个任务的专家路线都来自源实验室公布的记录和说明,每个任务都遵循同样的构造步骤.
我们考虑了大约375个候选来源,并保留了那些有闭合答案、可以支撑新读数的原始数据以及需要具体诊断的关键结果。
